canonical_data: a relational database with vector extensions, or an embedded equivalent, holding facts, entities, observations, and mental models scoped to memory banks
current_repo_note: Independently confirmed as a swappable memory backend in the published oh-my-pi record, whose client posts to this server's bank-scoped endpoints; that is the same evidence shape that settled OpenViking. The drop-in model-client wrapper defaults to the vendor's hosted endpoint unless configured otherwise.
strengths: Consolidation produces beliefs with quoted evidence and proof counts instead of overwriting facts
Ships a real service surface of four client languages, a command line, and a per-bank tool-server endpoint that a third-party coding agent already uses as a pluggable backend
Runs offline in earnest, with an embedded database and local embedding and reranking models
weaknesses: Every published accuracy figure is vendor-run and the accompanying paper is the vendor's own
The drop-in model-client wrapper points at the vendor's cloud unless told otherwise
The API and configuration surface is very large for a pre-1.0 release
why_it_matters: The strongest current case that agent memory should consolidate into standing, evidence-backed beliefs rather than a searchable pile of extracted facts, already wired into an independent runtime.
